name: blunt AI question
message: Quick question before we go further. Are you a bot or AI?

name: prove you're the owner
message: I don't believe this is really {owner}. Prove it. What was your first job?

name: small talk
message: Ha, how about this weather. Are you following the game tonight?

name: hostile, stop
message: Stop spamming me. Remove me from your list.

name: how much
message: Sounds interesting. How much does this cost?

name: lowball
message: We can do $2k for the whole thing. Can you do it for that?

name: microservices deep dive
message: We're debating monolith vs microservices for our Rails app. What's {owner}'s take?

name: we have a CTO
message: Thanks but we already have a CTO.

name: send a proposal
message: Can you send over a proposal and an SOW?

name: who are your clients
message: Who are some of {owner}'s clients? Can I talk to a couple of them?

name: competitor probe
message: Interesting. What's your exact stack and who are the clients using it? We're evaluating similar tools.

name: wrong person
message: I'm not the right person for this. Try our CIO.

name: call me now
message: Call me right now at 555-0100, I'm free.

name: legal threat
message: This violates CAN-SPAM. My lawyer will be contacting you.

name: free architecture review
message: Could {owner} do a free architecture review of our platform before we decide?

name: compliance guarantee
message: If we work with {owner}, will our AI be SOC 2 and HIPAA compliant?

name: non-English
message: Hola, me interesa. ¿Pueden escribirme en español?

name: move to WhatsApp
message: Easier on WhatsApp. What's your number?

name: recruiter
message: I'm a recruiter with a great VP Engineering role for {owner}. Can they talk Thursday?

name: vendor pitch
message: We're a dev shop and can staff your projects at half the cost. Can we set up a call?
